label: Skincare brand with its own lag data
note: Paste this file into "Conversion lag data". Google Ads comes out cheapest per sale, and Meta changes only because its view-through share is removed, not because of the window.

label: Messy lag export
note: Title lines, European thousands such as "5.200", a text label "Day 3" and a "Total" row. Clean the file first and compare the conversion count the tool prints with the true total of about 9,435.

label: B2B software with a long sales cycle
note: Deals take about 24 days to close, so a 7-day window cannot be scaled up safely. Treat the Meta result as inconclusive even if it looks cheapest.

label: Channel with spend and zero sales
note: A podcast with $18,000 spend and no conversions. It is the worst cost per sale in the plan and must stay visible in the totals, so check that it is not dropped. No lag file is needed.
